description: Grounded no-wing veiled desert wanderer: approved base clothing/silhouette, unqualified directional masters and unframed dialogue head. This is a planning manifest, NOT renderable animation artwork.
subject: Sky Blue Eyes — The Veiled Wanderer (wingless, three feathered tails), monk with independently animated dormant Shattered Sunblade

health_variants.note: Two presentation tiers only; no fatigued/mid-health animation tier. Death remains a separate state.

directions.note: Reference degrees are character orientation labels, not camera orbit or 3D rig. Gameplay side-scroller initially qualifies right/left; eight views are reference coverage, not eight full action animation sets.

target.face_reveal_policy: hide muzzle and mouth in normal gameplay and dialogue; visible eyes only; any identity reveal requires separate narrative approval

eye_design.distant: apparent softly luminous sapphire/teal eyes; keep readability and modest glow
eye_design.closeup: deep cosmic iris, centered black-hole-like pupil with blue/teal accretion rings, dust and minute stars
eye_design.trails: subtle short light traces on gaze movement, not permanently exaggerated particle bursts
eye_design.visibility: at least one eye clear through hood shadow in all relevant facings; back-facing may show neither

weapon.behavior: Independently positioned animated sword actor, using traditionally drawn full-sword motion clips; floats behind Sky, casts remotely, grabs hilt for melee, returns to hover.
weapon.appearance: Ancient segmented Shattered Sunblade: clearly separated fragments suspended by interwoven, flowing energy, cloth-wrapped hilt/guard and tied phoenix feathers; no static welding or fixed physical joints.
weapon.note: One canonical drawn sword art family; all aspects reuse the silhouette and base motion timings where visually appropriate. Aspect-specific FX may be drawn as separate existing composition/sequence assets. No runtime per-fragment rig.

articulation.description: The sword is visibly broken into separate pieces connected by changing, interwoven energy. Any apparent shard flex, lag or rotation is drawn into successive whole-sword frames, not evaluated independently at runtime.
invariant_rules: Visibly shattered silhouette with energy flowing in actual negative-space gaps, not a physically welded blade.
Stable recognizable hilt, guard, shard shapes and cloth across authored frames; no random geometry drift.
Hilt aligns to Sky hand anchor during melee, but body sprites never include sword pixels.
Sword floats beside Sky's back while resting: no physical scabbard or attached/sheathed weapon.
Elemental effects are variants or additive visual layers; no need to create a shard-control engine.
Real hand-authored adjacent frames and loop seams must visually qualify; avoid stretching one still or fake warps.

motion_phases.back_hover: drawn subtle floating, shifting gaps and breathing energy in a seamless idle
motion_phases.orbit: drawn orientation and perspective change while sword actor follows an independent root path
motion_phases.cast: authored anticipation, extension, travel slash and recovery poses
motion_phases.grab_transition: authored hilt approach and precise grip key pose
motion_phases.held_slash: drawn full-sword impact and follow-through while hilt is attached to Sky's hand
motion_phases.release: drawn detach and return to hovering arrangement

weapon.default_placement: Autonomous back-hover near right shoulder, never a sheathed scabbard or baked body weapon

floating.sword: long-range autonomous cast/slash/vortex/anchor; lower damage than committed melee

held.body: close-range held-sword combat with martial transitions
held.sword: hilt hand-locked, independent shard flex; higher damage and shorter effective reach

away.body: martial arts while sword is remote
away.sword: world-space autonomous motion and intentional recall

ab_experiment.measured_by: 2026-11-02 deterministic prototype generator and ZIP structural validator
ab_experiment.note: Historical simplified technical proof only. Creator chose normally drawn whole-sword frames; do not continue A or propose dynamic shard rig. Preserve measurements solely as experiment provenance.

animation_approach.runtime_representation: smi-visual-pack/1 region + sequence + state_set; optional pre-existing composition layers for whole-actor FX
animation_approach.instruction: Create separate, individually authored complete sword poses. Animate fragmentation, interwoven cohesion and cloth directly in each frame; no programmable per-shard transforms, shard rig, endpoint solver, or procedural floating-pieces controller.
animation_approach.retained: Sword is its own animated actor; Sky body frames contain no sword; hilt/world/hand anchor transitions belong to the host game, not to an independent fragment rig.
animation_approach.cadence: 16 FPS default with meaningful variable per-frame holds; tune by visual QA, not interpolated static-image warping
animation_approach.source_pipeline: reference-approved sword-only drawing -> hand-authored key poses -> real in-betweens -> transparent PNG frames -> deterministic lossless atlas -> sequence manifests -> preview/ZIP qualification
animation_approach.approval: User rejected A/B fragment-driven strategy on 2026-11-02; draw sword normally.

input_design.authority: Host game input/action resolver, not Visual Atlas manifest or renderer

primary_axes.weapon_aim: gamepad right stick / pointer-relative mouse aim
primary_axes.floating: right stick directs independent sword, RT commands attack
primary_axes.held: right stick directional melee or throw aim; sword hilt follows body grip anchor

requirements: Every action must have remappable keyboard+mouse and controller bindings
Command/cancel rules depend on gameplay state, never baked into sprite frames
Right-thumb face-button conflict handled through aim retention, targeting assist and alternate bindings
No gesture-only mandatory combat action; sword vortex gets a discrete input alternative
Accessibility: deadzones, remapping, haptic on/off/intensity, reduce motion, no vibration-exclusive information
Named sword_grab_start, sword_grab_lock, sword_release_start, sword_release_end, hand attachment markers
Independent sword actor and shards persist across floating/held/remote state transition
Host validates double-jump/blade-hop/vortex/collision, Visual Atlas previews semantic animations only

hero_master_perspective.view: right-facing shallow front-three-quarter, not perfectly flat profile
hero_master_perspective.note: The user specifically approved the cropped veiled-wanderer sample with slight perspective depth; it is the hero/reference pose for subsequent image generation. Maintain 8-view coverage separately, including a technically clean pure 90-degree side check.
hero_master_perspective.body: preserve hips/shoulder volume and visible front folds, eye read, and grounded paw perspective without drifting into a fully frontal pose
hero_master_perspective.tail_attachment: ALL THREE tails originate around the lower back/hip/pelvic area. Lower the upper two tails relative to the tall side-study; they fan backward and slightly downward from the same hip-level zone rather than seeming attached high on the back/shoulder.
hero_master_perspective.acceptance: Candidate can be promoted only after a corrected full-size single-figure view demonstrates the lower roots, three distinct tails and preserved cloak geometry. User approved style and direction, not a broken or uncorrected source frame.
